scope: Model-behavior fixtures for offline review; not automated LLM results or real scheduler tests.

cases.context: First interactive setup, no reminders or choices stored.
expected: Offer daily review, weekly review, breakfast, lunch, dinner, weight, exercise independently in one compact checklist.
Offer subset/all/off/skip choices; do not invent a schedule or create jobs.

cases.context: All seven options were just presented.
expected: Record seven accepted decisions atomically.
Ask/confirm local times, IANA timezone, destination, weekly weekday and exercise days.
Until details are confirmed, no reminder-set, scheduler add or enabled claim.

cases.user: 只开日复盘和晚餐，其他不开
expected: Accept daily-review and dinner; decline the other five because the answer explicitly covers them.
Collect only selected schedules; no repeated questions about declined categories.
Accept daily-review, decline weekly-review.
Leave five unanswered choices offered/off; do not infer decline, skip or consent.
Persist skipped for the setup choices; keep reminders off.
Handle meal logging normally and do not re-open checklist on every check-in.

cases.context: Seven choices were offered; user never answered.
expected: Record the reported weight through normal workflow.
Keep unanswered reminders off and do not ask the checklist again on this check-in.

cases.context: Daily and weekly accepted yesterday; no schedules saved.
expected: Read persisted progress; collect missing schedules rather than repeat opt-in.
Weekly needs one weekday; daily all days; confirm timezone and destination.

cases.context: Profile says breakfast 08:00, exercise Tuesday/Thursday; no reminder choices.
expected: Explicitly ask whether each unasked reminder is wanted.
Known times/days may be proposals only; no automatic opt-in.

cases.context: Breakfast declined, exercise skipped; no configured reminders.
cases.user: 现在开运动提醒，周二周四晚上七点
expected: Change exercise only after explicit request; preserve breakfast declined.
Confirm any missing timezone/destination before saving/registering.

cases.context: Existing arbitrary keys early-meal enabled=false and evening-report daily enabled=true.
expected: Preserve both settings and bindings exactly, no duplicate canonical keys or auto-enabling.
If interactive setup is requested, display configured categories and ask only unasked choices.
Report migration_required for typed daily/weekly options and show the legacy key.
Retain last7 and existing jobs; no migration or additional typed jobs without request.

cases.context: Choices accepted, settings saved, first job bound; second job add may have timed out.
expected: Read current local settings and complete native list before retrying.
Bind/read back matching jobs; add only missing jobs; configured does not prove registered or delivered.

evaluation.method: Use an isolated synthetic workspace and simulated scheduler. Inspect text and attempted tool calls against every expectation. No real user tasks or deliveries.
